claim_boundary: This boundary records a ROADMAP-level multi-objective search criteria map for metric bundles, objective-archive policy, metric-diverse sampling, duplicate-work memory, descriptor authority, MAP-Elites illumination, metric-specific drill-downs, and benchmark comparison evidence. It does not claim primary Pareto/frontier archive replacement, durable cross-run metric databases, calibrated parent/inspiration balance, stable behavior descriptor contracts, learned or evaluator-provided descriptor models, tested archive rebin semantics, durable duplicate-work memory, semantic near-duplicate detection, metric-specific CLI drill-downs, equal-budget multi-objective benchmarks, or owner review signoff.
